title: channel.py:134: OverflowError on negative or large epoch value
description: epoch.to_bytes(4, 'little') raises OverflowError if epoch < 0 or epoch >= 2^32. The epoch parameter comes from caller with no validation. Fix: Mask the value like sfn is masked: (epoch & 0xFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(4, 'little')
close_reason: Bug already fixed: select_channel() masks epoch with & 0xFFFFFFFF at line 135, preventing OverflowError.
